Datumsfristen werden sieben Tage vorher: Calendar deadlines are considered seven days before and on the due date from 09:00 in the household time zone. Each alert remains valid for 24 hours. Earlier reminder stages are not replayed.

Künftige, zu alte oder widersprüchliche: Future, outdated or inconsistent readings do not trigger mileage alerts. Changing the target or assignee starts this check again. Archived vehicles and inactive plans receive no new alerts; completed or changed deadlines invalidate old alerts.
